Six dimensions, D1-D6, same order everywhere.'); src/components/operations/OperationsLedger.tsx and RegionDimensionMatrix.tsx (real components)
notes: FIXED, fix lane fix58-detail (2026-09-07): OperationsLedger.tsx's `MATRIX_DIMENSIONS` (feeding RegionDimensionMatrix's `dimensions` prop, ~line 356) was `= DIMENSIONS` already at the time this lane read the file — the retired `SOURCED_DIMENSIONS = DIMENSIONS.filter((d) => d.key !== "regulatory")` derivation this note used to describe is gone from the product; the file's own DEFECT-FIX comment above `MATRIX_DIMENSIONS` (2026-09-07) records the same change. The MISMATCH this spec measured was the audit mount (`mounts.mjs`'s `ops-matrix` entry) still hardcoding the retired 5-item `SOURCED_DIMENSIONS` shape — a stale harness fixture, not a live product defect. The mount now reproduces the real `MATRIX_DIMENSIONS = DIMENSIONS` (all 6, unfiltered).

The artboard's OWN 'Regions side by side' matrix table (p8, the <table> under the 'six dimensions per region' dek) shows only 5 rows in its example markup, no Regulatory feasibility row — a self-contradiction against its own 'six dimensions' dek text. Operator ruling 3.3 is the binding, later statement over the artboard's own example: 'Operations matrix renders 5 of 6 dimensions; add D6 Regulatory Feasibility... same order everywhere' — built against, per this dispatch's framing of the closed rulings.

`buildRegionGrid` (region-grid.mjs) computes `state: 'absent'` for every regulatory_feasibility cell (0 rows in regional_data_facts, always) and RegionDimensionMatrix's own empty-cell branch renders the shared `Absence` component for any `state === 'absent'` cell — the D1 row therefore renders with the Absence convention in every cell, never a fabricated count, never blank.
